title: 건널목 개량촉진법 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Designation of Level Crossings for Improvement)
(1) Where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport or a Special Metropolitan City Mayor, Metropolitan City Mayor, Special Self-Governing City Mayor or Do Governor (hereinafter referred to as a "Mayor/Do Governor") deems it necessary to provide grade separation at an existing level crossing or to improve its structure to prevent traffic accidents and facilitate smooth traffic flow, the Minister or Mayor/Do Governor shall designate it as a level crossing for improvement after consultation with the relevant administrative agencies. In such cases, a Mayor/Do Governor may designate a level crossing for improvement only where the entire expenses are to be borne by the Mayor/Do Governor or by a Mayor of a Si, head of a Gun or head of a Gu (meaning the head of a self-governing Gu) pursuant to Article 8 (1).
(2) Where the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport or a Mayor/Do Governor designates a level crossing for improvement pursuant to paragraph (1), the Minister or Mayor/Do Governor shall notify the railroad facility manager and road management authority thereof and publicly notify the designation.
(3) Matters necessary for the criteria for designating level crossings for improvement shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
